comment: Findings of the vulnerability watch that the owner has triaged. An entry is reported by the watch but does not fail the run, until its reviewAfter date has passed. Fields: id (CVE, GHSA or watch id), component (as in the watch table), decision (not-affected, fixed-in-next-release or accepted), reason, date and reviewAfter (yyyy-MM-dd).

acknowledgements.reason: The vulnerable code is the .recover command of the sqlite3 command-line shell. The package runs sqlite3.exe only from Database-Storage (Storage.Audit.cs): -safe -readonly -batch -json with one fixed SELECT, no .recover or any other dot-command, and only its JSON output is read. The operator supplies a database path and a tool path that must hash to the pinned executable. 3.54.1 is the latest release and has no fix.
The vulnerable code is the .recover command of the sqlite3 command-line shell, which is not part of the e_sqlite3 library that the collector loads. 3.54.1 is the latest SQLite release and has no fix.
A PHP PDO::quote() flaw (PHP before 8.0.27, 8.1.15 and 8.2.2) that NVD matched to the SQLite CPE. It is not SQLite code and the package contains no PHP.
